title: maleCNS-depth: pre-registration and analysis code for the certified information-breaking depth of the male Drosophila CNS connectome
description:
Freeze of the confirmatory analysis of a pre-registered study of the synapse-flow Markov chain of the male Drosophila central nervous system connectome (male-cns v1.0, FlyEM and collaborators, CC-BY).

This release adds the confirmatory scripts for the five pre-registered hypotheses H1 to H5 (code/confirmatory/), tested on synthetic data only, and the dated entries D7 and C1 to C8 of DEVIATIONS.md, which fix every definition the pre-registration leaves open. None of H1 to H5 had been computed on the connectome when this release was made. The pre-registration itself was published in the registration record v0.1.0-prereg (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22980248), byte-identical to the text frozen on 19 September 2026.
